description: Offers financial assistance to farmers in Uttar Pradesh to purchase modern agricultural equipment such as laser land levelers, rotavators, tractors, seed drills, and power tillers.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on selected agricultural machinery (higher percentages apply to small, marginal, and SC/ST farmers).
eligibility: Resident farmers of Uttar Pradesh registered on the UP Agriculture Portal (Pardarshi Kisan Seva Yojana)

description: A comprehensive social security and insurance scheme that provides financial protection to agricultural families in UP against accidental death, permanent disability, and emergency medical costs.
benefits: Accidental death/disability coverage up to ₹5 Lakh, along with emergency hospitalization coverage up to ₹2.5 Lakh.
eligibility: Head of household/farmer residing in Uttar Pradesh aged 18 to 70 years
Annual family income below ₹75,000 or landless/marginal farmers
documents: Khasra/Khatauni (Land Record) or BPL Ration Card
application_mode: Online via UP Social Welfare Portal / District Agriculture Office

description: Provides financial aid for installing low-voltage solar fencing around farm perimeters to protect standing crops from wild and stray animals without causing harm to animals.
benefits: Subsidy up to 60% (maximum ₹1.43 Lakh per hectare) for installing solar-powered crop protection fencing.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of Uttar Pradesh
Available for individual or cluster farm plots

scheme_name: UP Agris Scheme (Agricultural Resilient & Inclusive Systems)
description: A World Bank-assisted flagship initiative targeting climate resilience, crop diversification (pulses, oilseeds), seed sovereignty, and post-harvest supply chain development across Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Direct subsidies on climate-resilient seed varieties, bio-pesticides, drip irrigation setups, and cold storage linkage grants.
eligibility: Farmers, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) operating in UP
documents: FPO Registration Certificate (if applying as FPO)

description: A statewide extension and capacity-building initiative conducted at the Gram Panchayat level to train farmers in modern cropping techniques, soil health management, natural farming, and government scheme awareness.
benefits: Free practical field training, soil testing kits, complimentary high-yield seed mini-kits, and direct connection with agricultural scientists.
eligibility: Open to all farmers residing in Uttar Pradesh
documents: Kisan Credit Card / UP Kisan Registration
application_mode: Direct participation at Village Panchayat Training Centers

description: Encourages farmers to replace diesel irrigation pumps with eco-friendly solar-powered pumps, reducing operational costs and supporting sustainable irrigation.
benefits: 60% overall subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on 2 HP, 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP standalone solar pump installations.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with a valid water source (borewell/well)
Farmers who have not previously availed solar pump subsidies
application_mode: Online via UP Agriculture Portal (e-lottery mode)

description: Designed to encourage crop diversification away from water-intensive rice-wheat cycles toward high-value pulses (Gram, Arhar, Urad) and oilseeds (Mustard, Groundnut).
benefits: Free certified seed mini-kits (up to 100% subsidy) and specialized bio-fertilizer packages.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers willing to allocate land for pulses and oilseed cultivation in notified districts
application_mode: Online portal registration / Local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) - Crop & Livestock Loan UP
description: Provides short-term credit facilities at heavily subsidized interest rates to meet agricultural, animal husbandry, and dairy operational costs.
benefits: Institutional credit up to ₹3 Lakh (extended to ₹5 Lakh) at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum upon prompt repayment.
eligibility: Individual landowning farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, and dairy/poultry farmers in UP
application_mode: Online via Banks / CSCs / Land Development Banks

description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) specifically for sugarcane, horticulture, and commercial crops to improve water-use efficiency.
benefits: Subsidies ranging between 80% to 90% for small and marginal farmers on drip and sprinkler hardware installation.
eligibility: Farmers growing sugarcane, horticultural, or vegetable crops in Uttar Pradesh with available irrigation sources

scheme_name: Pardarshi Kisan Seva Yojana (UP Farmer Registration)
description: The unified Single-Sign-On portal for Uttar Pradesh farmers that links all state and central agricultural subsidies (seeds, fertilizers, machinery, solar) directly to their bank accounts.
benefits: Single window access to all state farm schemes and direct benefit transfers without intermediary deductions.
eligibility: All resident agricultural landholders in Uttar Pradesh
application_mode: Online via Portal or nearest CSC / Jan Seva Kendra
